# badge

> Auth and agent identity, proven rather than assumed: an agent-native, self-improving auth employee that coding agents call through a CLI, an MCP server and skills.

badge owns AuthN, AuthZ, SSO/SCIM and agent identity. It scaffolds a real sign-in into an app, classifies any agent-auth task as P1, P2, P3 or P4, audits OAuth and MCP configs against the 2026-05-31 CVE class, triages SAML/SSO failures and plans provider migrations. Its master rule: an agent's authority is the strict intersection of agent and user permissions, never the union. Spec target: MCP 2025-11-25, CIMD before DCR. It does not do payments (penny), the login-box UI (pixel), the users-table schema (acorn) or deploy and CI (rocket).

Run it from GitHub with no clone: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/badge badge --help` for the CLI and `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/badge badge-mcp` for the MCP server (stdio). Every CLI command takes `--json`.

## Agent guide

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the one guide for every coding agent: the tools, the P1-P4 router, the boundary and what not to do.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): operating rules for Claude Code in this repository (it imports AGENTS.md).
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who badge is, its tagline, its voice and its boundaries.
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, the quick start, and how to install it in any coding agent.

## CLI (`badge`)

- [init](src/cli/init.ts): `badge init --provider <clerk|betterauth|workos|stytch> [--target <dir>]` scaffolds a working sign-in to protected-route flow.
- [classify](src/cli/classify.ts): `badge classify "<task>"` places the plane and classifies P1/P2/P3/P4, with the default tool and the reason.
- [advise](src/cli/advise.ts): `badge advise --use-case <consumer|b2b|enterprise|self-host> [--mau <n>]` returns a provider decision with price breakpoints.
- [audit](src/cli/audit.ts): `badge audit <path> [--mcp|--scim|--agent|--saml]` runs the pitfall checklist and gives each finding a severity and a fix.
- [saml-triage](src/cli/saml-triage.ts): `badge saml-triage "<symptom>"` runs the 7-step SAML/SSO triage runbook.
- [migrate](src/cli/migrate.ts): `badge migrate --from <provider> --to <provider>` plans a dual-validation window and names the four casualties.
- [mcp-check](src/cli/mcp-check.ts): `badge mcp-check <url>` walks an MCP server's OAuth discovery and reports spec gaps.
- [runs](src/cli/runs.ts): `badge runs [--since <ts>]` summarises the run log in `logs/runs.jsonl`.

## MCP server (`badge-mcp`)

- [src/mcp/server.ts](src/mcp/server.ts): the stdio server. Tools: `badge_classify`, `badge_advise`, `badge_audit`, `badge_saml_triage`, `badge_migrate`, `badge_mcp_check`. Resources: `badge://brain/{file}`.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the config any MCP client can copy; it starts the server from GitHub.

## Skills

- [skills/agent-auth-classifier/SKILL.md](skills/agent-auth-classifier/SKILL.md): when an agent needs auth: classify P1-P4, apply the intersection rule, refuse the six anti-patterns.
- [skills/auth-provider-selection/SKILL.md](skills/auth-provider-selection/SKILL.md): when choosing an auth provider or pricing auth at scale.
- [skills/mcp-oauth-audit/SKILL.md](skills/mcp-oauth-audit/SKILL.md): when checking an MCP server or OAuth provider against the 2025-11-25 spec.
- [skills/saml-sso-triage/SKILL.md](skills/saml-sso-triage/SKILL.md): when SSO or SAML breaks in production.
- [skills/auth-migration-planner/SKILL.md](skills/auth-migration-planner/SKILL.md): when switching auth providers without logging anyone out.

## Sub-agents

- [.claude/agents/badge-provider-auditor.md](.claude/agents/badge-provider-auditor.md): a fresh-context auditor that runs the full pitfall checklist on a repository.
- [.claude/agents/badge-migration-planner.md](.claude/agents/badge-migration-planner.md): a fresh-context planner for a migration with no forced logouts.

## Brain (what badge knows)

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the decision spine badge runs on every task, including the P1-P4 router.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): 16 named, dated auth incidents and how each was resolved.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): version-pinned CVEs and library traps, each with how to detect and avoid it.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](brain/OPINIONS.md): 35 taste stances (always X, never Y, because Z).
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where the field disagrees, which badge flags rather than bluffs.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): the default and alternative provider per job, and the watchlist.

## Install surfaces

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, the auth-lint hook, the MCP server).
- [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): the one-plugin marketplace, so `/plugin marketplace add naman10parikh/badge` works.
- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): the plugin's auth-lint hook.
- [gemini-extension.json](gemini-extension.json): the Gemini CLI extension.
- [.well-known/agent.json](.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card.

## Self-improvement

- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract (eval-gated, no self-grading, git snapback).
- [workflows/rsi.workflow.js](workflows/rsi.workflow.js): the scheduled loop that watches the field, flags changes and re-runs the evals.
- [eval/run.mjs](eval/run.mjs): the eval pyramid (14 golden tasks and a labelled classification set).
